title: Agentic Workspace Local Mixed-Agent Override
description: Human configuration. Unknown fields are rejected; absence uses owner defaults.

enabled.description: Machine-local override for whether ordinary Agentic Workspace operation should run in this repository. When false, ordinary commands return a disabled-state packet; set true here to re-enable even if repo config disables AW.

cli_invoke.description: Command prefix this machine should show in copyable Agentic Workspace commands, such as `uv run agentic-workspace`.

shared_config_path.description: Optional path to another machine-local Agentic Workspace local config file. Relative paths resolve from the repository root; repo-local local config values override shared values.

workspace.description: Local workspace preferences that should not be checked into shared repo config.

safe_to_auto_run_commands.description: Whether this local environment may automatically run configured commands when another local policy explicitly permits automation.

requires_human_verification_on_pr.description: Whether pull request or review closeout on this machine should remain lower-trust until a human verifies it.

safety.description: Local safety limits for command execution and verification.

assignment_policy.description: Whether work stays local by default, receives advisory best-fit routing, or must bind to the best available configured target before implementation claims.

transport_authority.description: Whether an executable admitted transport selected after assignment requires manual fallback or may run automatically within the independent safety ceiling.

current_target.description: Name of the delegation target profile representing the current runtime. Required to claim mandatory best-fit enforcement.

human_override_policy.description: When a human override may replace the selected assignment and what provenance is required.

required_execution_guarantees.description: Hard execution constraints checked before best-fit comparison. Only source-current adapter guarantees satisfy them; unknown names or unsupported guarantees leave a route ineligible. Names are extensible and do not select a provider or continuity mode.

delegation.description: Machine-local delegation control. This decides how far local tooling may go after recommending stay-local, stronger-reasoning, external-delegation, or manual-handoff.

mode.description: Local control mode for clarification: stop and ask before proceeding when intent is unclear, surface the ask-human option without forcing it, or continue with the best bounded interpretation unless a hard blocker is present.

clarification.description: Machine-local clarification control for when agents should stop for human input instead of guessing or widening scope.

enabled.description: Whether this checkout should keep ignored local AW command session logs.

path_mode.description: Canonical setting for how local filesystem paths should be represented in session log markdown, indexes, and summaries.

session_logging.description: Machine-local session logging and path-normalization preferences.

target_id.description: Stable user-local target identity used by orchestration and target guidance. Display names and aliases alone are not sufficient identity.

target_revision.description: Optional model, runtime, or target generation/revision identifier for continuity decisions.

aliases.description: Previous or alternate local profile names. Ambiguous aliases fail closed.

identity_status.description: Human-owned target eligibility/lifecycle control. Any non-active value prohibits execution; it does not report observed runtime availability.

execution_guarantees.description: Current provider-neutral local execution capability facts; replaces overlapping target task/strength routing fields.

location.description: Where this target runs from the current machine's perspective: local, external, or either. This is a local availability and boundary hint.

confidence.description: Human-authored advisory prior for this target profile from 0 to 1. Admitted lifecycle outcomes belong to the target-evidence owner and must not rewrite this configuration. This prior grants no execution or completion authority.

transports.description: Canonical constructible transport variants. Process/API payload is inseparable from its method; internal readiness is resolved against runtime support.

cost_class.description: Advisory relative cost class used for down-routing only when quality and proof remain safe.

latency_class.description: Advisory relative latency class for local routing tradeoffs.

forbidden_task_classes.description: Capability classes this target must not execute directly, regardless of model confidence.

confidence_source.description: Optional provenance of the human-authored advisory prior. New evaluation or lifecycle observations belong to the target-evidence owner, not configuration.

^.+$.description: One local delegation target profile. Availability fields are human-owned controls; confidence, task fit, and capability classes are advisory estimates.

delegation_targets.description: Named local delegation targets available to this runtime.
